args.subject: Currency Correction & Refund – Invoice for C-8044
args.body:
Dear Fabrikam Ltd,

Thank you for flagging the currency issue on your recent invoice. We have corrected the record to reflect that the invoice was issued in USD, and we have issued a refund of 310 to cover the conversion loss, as you were eligible.

If you have any further questions, please reach out to your account team.

Best regards,
IT Operations
